thread:
maria: Deploy bot flagged: canary p95 regressed by ~28% after cutover. Deploy-bot suggests auto-rollback to v3.7.1. It's inside our change window. Should we allow auto-rollback or hold for manual verification? cc @lee @ash

deploy-bot: [BOT] Auto-rollback conditions met: p95 > 20% baseline, error-rate > 3%. Proposed action: rollback to ref v3.7.1. runbook: /run rollback --to v3.7.1 --slice canary. (signal id 0x43af) :warning:

lee: :eyes: What's the customer impact? Any 5xxs or embeddings flakiness?

ash: Observed elevated tail latency but errors are limited to 502 gateway spikes for edge-2. No persistent customer errors reported. I'm seeing KV cache miss spike correlating with the new kernel flag.

niko: I'm oncall. I recommend manual rollback. We should pin traffic back to the previous canary and run a full smoke on v3.7.1 before promoting.

maria: Agree. Let's not let deploy-bot fully auto-rollback without ops approval. We set the rule to "manual-confirm" for this change window due to several Dedicated customers. Is everyone ok with manual exec?

lee: +1. also update release notes: mention kernel flag and known KV cache regression. Customer comms draft ready if we escalate.

ash: Manual steps (for whoever executes):
1) tag: git rev-parse --short HEAD v3.7.1
2) rollback command:
```
/deploy rollback --service inference --to v3.7.1 --traffic-slice canary --notify stakeholders
```
3) pin in console -> models -> active -> lock v3.7.1
4) monitor p95 and error-rate for 10m

srebot: Monitor policy applied: alert @oncall if p95 > baseline+15% after rollback. Retention of logs increased to 72h for this slice.

maria: I'll take exec. @niko can you prep the smoke checklist and notify Dedicated customers? @lee can you update release notes and send quick blurb to #customer-notify if we roll?

niko: On it. Smoke checklist:
- generate 50 test requests at 3 token lengths
- check kv-hit/miss rate
- validate embedding consistency
ETA 6m.

lee: Draft sent to #customer-notify: "We've observed a performance regression in our canary; rolling back to v3.7.1 for stability. No expected data loss." Will update when rollback completes.

deploy-bot: [BOT] Rollback queued by maria at 3032109930. Exec in progress... :gear:

maria: Executed rollback, monitoring now. p95 down to baseline+4% after 3m. Leaving pinned until EOD. Will file postmortem and add regression test to e2e.

ash: Thanks. After EOD let's decide whether to hotfix the kernel or revert the flag in the next patch.
